|strategy=By [mailto:grimnok@yahoo.com Eric Olson]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/sebulba.html</ref>

If Jar Jar is the problem, then [[Sebulba]] is the answer. [[Sebulba]] can permanently deal with Jar Jar if the Gungan is foolish enough to wander over to the same location as [[Sebulba]]. There won't be any more [[Brisky Morning Munchen]] once [[Sebulba]] is finished turning Jar Jar into orange goo!

[[Sebulba]] is also a solid choice for any alien based decks. 4 power for 3 deploy is a good deal, but with his ability to reduce an opposing character's power, it's almost as if he had 7 power! And he can help his good buddy [[Snoova]] and his Vibro Ax capture large hairy Wookies from time to time, too, making [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]] an easy mark.
